options.name: custom_fields
options.description: The label, or type, of the user added customer field in record that contains the value. If the value has a complex value, use notation to get the specific value from the complex value.

options.name: fields
options.description: The label, or type, of the standard field in record that contains the value. If the value has a complex value, use notation to get the specific value from the complex value.

options.name: generate_password
options.description: Generate any passwords that has not been set.

options.name: notes
options.description: Attach a note to the record. C(note) (singular) is accepted as a deprecated alias.

options.name: password_complexity
options.description: Control the content of the password.

options.name: record_type
options.description: The type if record to create.

options.name: shared_folder_uid
options.description: The UID of the top-level shared folder in your Keeper application. Must be a shared folder UID, not a subfolder UID.
